message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and for once, I felt like the hero of the evening! I grabbed my trusty flashlight, powered up my phone with a fully charged power bank, and even set up one of those cozy lanterns to keep the mood light. My family was impressed, and honestly, I was a little proud of myself for being prepared this time! It was a reminder that a little planning can turn a frustrating situation into a fun family adventure. What’s your go-to tip for handling power outages?
